claims.statement: For every Boolean pair g,h and coordinate i, the signed U-collision satisfies delta_i C = Delta_i U(gh)-Delta_i U(g)-Delta_i U(h); over every branch-dependent adaptive physical restriction tree, the reach-weighted internal drifts equal the root collision minus the reach-weighted terminal collisions.
claims.scope: All finite uniform cubes, arbitrary adaptive coordinate choices, arbitrary pruning and terminal depths; exact actual reach weights and explicit terminal reserve.

claims.statement: For D_{a,b}=G-aI-bU, every Boolean product satisfies D(gh)=D(g)+D(h)+LC(g,h)+2aJ(g,h)-bC(g,h), where J is total joint pivotal probability. Iteration gives the exact signed composition-forest GU criterion.
claims.scope: Every a>=0 and real b; the FEI implication is invoked only for 0<=b<1 and a restriction-closed universal construction.

claims.statement: The universal helper R_{a,b}(g,h)<=0 at every overlapping product node is false for every admissible a,b. A three-bit Boolean pair has C>0, LC=3C, J=1/2 and hence R=(3-b)C+a>0.
claims.scope: Certified exact witness; this refutes only termwise product closure, not universal GU or FEI.

claims.statement: Adaptive collision drift now telescopes exactly, but the simultaneous all-coordinate G collision and joint-pivotal cost still need a global companion-sign/posterior/terminal allocation with single-use ownership.
